html:
Denis Sassou Nguesso is a Congolese army officer who was president of the Republic of the Congo from 1979 to 1992 and again from 1997, ruling it for most of the time since independence.

From the north of the country, he led the People's Republic as head of its single party, then lost the first multiparty election in 1992. He came back by force in the civil war of 1997, with his Cobra militia and Angolan troops.

Since then he has won elections that critics call unfair, and a referendum in 2015 removed the age and term limits that would have stopped him. His family has been investigated in France over wealth drawn from oil, the base of the state he built in Brazzaville.
sum: Denis Sassou Nguesso is a Congolese army officer who was president of the Republic of the Congo from 1979 to 1992 and again from 1997, ruling it for most of the time since independence.
